ترتجلوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِلُوا (tartajilū) /tar.ta.d͡ʒi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# تُرْتَجَلُوا (turtajalū) /tur.ta.d͡ʒa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
